IsTruncated.description_en: Indicates whether the result is truncated because of the maxRows limit

RowCount.description_en: The number of rows returned in this response
RowCount.title: 返回行数

Rows.description_en: A two-dimensional array where each row is an array
Rows.description_zh: 二维数组，每行一个数组
Rows.title: 结果行数据

TotalRows.title: 总行数

description_en: Executes an SQL query directly on the EventHouse associated with a Luma Agent and returns structured results. Unlike AskLuma, this operation executes the SQL provided by the caller without natural language rewriting
description_zh: 在 Luma Agent 所属的 EventHouse 上直接执行 SQL 查询并返回结构化结果。与 AskLuma 不同，本接口执行调用方给定的 SQL，不做自然语言改写
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge query-luma-with-sql --agent-name my_agent --sql SELECT_0_FROM_my_table_LIMIT_10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryLumaWithSQL

parameters.help_en: Rows exceeding this limit are truncated. The IsTruncated field in the response indicates whether truncation occurred
parameters.help_zh: 超出部分被截断，响应中的 IsTruncated 会标记截断
parameters.name: max_rows

Code.description_en: The response code of the operation. A value of Success indicates that the call succeeded. Otherwise, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The execution result of the SQL query, including column definitions and row data
Data.description_zh: SQL 查询的执行结果，包含列定义与行数据

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value is Operation success if the call succeeds, or a specific error description if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Use this ID for troubleshooting and when submitting a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
